description: Manage typed graph relationships between nodes. Supported actions: add (create typed relationship), remove (delete relationship), batch_add (create multiple relationships atomically), link_visual (link task or artifact to visual memory state).

action.description: The edge management action to execute.

edges.description: Array of edge objects for batch_add.

properties.description: Optional metadata properties for the edge.

relationship.description: Relationship type for link_visual (e.g. renders_state, blocked_by_visual_state).

source_url.description: Optional URL where the visual state was captured.

visual_description.description: Optional text description for the visual state.

visual_state_id.description: Visual Memory snapshot/state ID for link_visual.

name: manage_edges
